    11|/-!
    12|# Group Extensions
    13|
    14|This file defines extensions of multiplicative and additive groups and their associated structures
    15|such as splittings and equivalences.
    16|
    17|## Main definitions
    18|
    19|- `(Add?)GroupExtension N E G`: structure for extensions of `G` by `N` as short exact sequences
    20|  `1 → N → E → G → 1` (`0 → N → E → G → 0` for additive groups)
    21|- `(Add?)GroupExtension.Equiv S S'`: structure for equivalences of two group extensions `S` and `S'`
    22|  as specific homomorphisms `E → E'` such that each diagram below is commutative
    23|
    24|```text
    25|For multiplicative groups:
    26|      ↗︎ E  ↘
    27|1 → N   ↓    G → 1
    28|      ↘︎ E' ↗︎️
    29|
    30|For additive groups:
    31|      ↗︎ E  ↘
    32|0 → N   ↓    G → 0
    33|      ↘︎ E' ↗︎️
    34|```
    35|
    36|- `(Add?)GroupExtension.Section S`: structure for right inverses to `rightHom` of a group extension
    37|  `S` of `G` by `N`
    38|- `(Add?)GroupExtension.Splitting S`: structure for section homomorphisms of a group extension `S`
    39|  of `G` by `N`
    40|- `SemidirectProduct.toGroupExtension φ`: the multiplicative group extension associated to the
    41|  semidirect product coming from `φ : G →* MulAut N`, `1 → N → N ⋊[φ] G → G → 1`
    42|
    43|## TODO
    44|
    45|If `N` is abelian,
    46|
    47|- there is a bijection between `N`-conjugacy classes of
    48|  `(SemidirectProduct.toGroupExtension φ).Splitting` and `groupCohomology.H1`
    49|  (which will be available in the planned file `Mathlib/GroupTheory/GroupExtension/Abelian.lean` to
    50|  be added in a later PR).
    51|- there is a bijection between equivalence classes of group extensions and `groupCohomology.H2`
    52|  (which is also stated as a TODO in `Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/GroupCohomology/LowDegree.lean`).
    53|-/
